decisions.statement: A service names another here only where being deployed past that one's commit would break.
Two services that reach each other and bear the skew name each other by nothing.
This edge is a version one service holds another to rather than a reach.
A service naming one still wanting a deploy is held back until that one has it.
A service a person deploys by hand is held back by nothing here.

definition: a service this one is never deployed ahead of
